facts.text: In the proposed earth-moving-machine intervention ladder, monitoring advances to information when an object is in the risk area and the stopping margin is healthy.

facts.text: In the earth-moving-machine intervention ladder, slowing advances to partial braking when the margin approaches its minimum.

facts.text: In the earth-moving-machine intervention ladder, partial braking advances to maximum safe braking when collision would otherwise be unavoidable.
